modes.scope_zh: 仅 MMLU-Pro 固定 200 题；B0/B1 各跑同一组 200 题。
modes.scope_en: MMLU-Pro fixed200 only; the same 200 questions in each of B0 and B1.

modes.scope_zh: 跑完冻结标准的全部五项：MMLU200、HLE 分层 200、Frontier160、SWE trace 32 任务（64 请求/臂）、Terminal trace 32 任务（48 请求/臂）。
modes.scope_en: All five frozen profiles: MMLU200, HLE stratified200, Frontier160, SWE trace32 tasks (64 requests/arm), Terminal trace32 tasks (48 requests/arm).

scope_zh: “全量”指本项目冻结的五项测试范围，不是五个上游数据集的原始全集。快速测试是单数据集检查，不能替代五项验收。SWE/Terminal 仅回放公开 trace 测推理性能，不执行历史工具命令，不报告任务解决率。
scope_en: Full means all five project-frozen profiles, not every item in the five upstream datasets. Quick is a single-dataset check and cannot replace five-profile acceptance. SWE/Terminal replay public traces for inference only; no historical tool commands are executed and no task success rate is reported.

timing.reference_zh: 参考配置：双卡 Ascend 910B2、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16，原版 B0 0.18 / 冻结 B1 r6，串行配对。
timing.reference_en: Reference: dual Ascend 910B2, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16, original B0 0.18 / frozen B1 r6, serial pairing.
timing.includes_zh: 五数据集主流程估时包含本机 C8、两臂加载与预热、推理、评分和报告。
timing.includes_en: Five-profile estimates include local C8, both-arm loading/warmup, inference, scoring and reporting.
timing.excludes_zh: 首次下载、环境安装和资源排队另计；32K、多租户和有效算力分子采集专项单列。已有参考分母自动核验缓存。
timing.excludes_en: Downloads, installation and queues are additional;32K, multi-tenant and compute numerator captures are separate. Existing reference denominators are automatically verified and cached.
timing.basis_zh: 基于当前 r6 报告中15个封存阶段的耗时合计：全量约11.13小时，快速约2.44小时；展示排期范围为加上余量后的估算。
timing.basis_en: Based on all15 sealed stages in the current r6 report: about11.13 hours full and2.44 hours quick, with planning allowance added.
timing.qualified_zh: 仅在同机同配置已有有效、封存的 C8 资格证据并通过脚本校验时，才可显式传 --continuous-evidence 复用；新第三方机器应重跑。复用后快速约 1–2 小时，全量约 10–14 小时。
timing.qualified_en: Reuse C8 only with valid sealed evidence for the same host/configuration, explicitly supplied through --continuous-evidence and verified by the runner. New third-party hosts must rerun it. With valid reuse: quick about 1–2 h; full about 10–14 h.

observed_components.basis: Completed selected stages only; failed/unselected stages are not counted. Source campaigns are retained unchanged.

execution.note_zh: 当前固定r6执行器；按部署清单设置模型、SDK、卡号与新结果目录，默认跟随日志。有效算力自动核验并缓存原同工况参考分母，本轮效率另按匹配分子重算。
execution.note_en: Current pinned r6 runner with local model/SDK/device paths and live logs. Compute-reference denominator statistics are automatically verified and cached; current efficiency requires matched numerator measurements.
execution.acceptance_zh: 报告逐项展示执行计数、质量、性能、参考算力、上下文与成本结论。
execution.acceptance_en: The report lists execution counts, quality, performance, compute reference, context and cost results.
execution.native_reference_cache_isolation: New native-reference captures use a fresh namespace per capture and a distinct salt per warmup/measured request; the existing A01 used frozen toolsr4.
execution.project_milestone_scope: Original qualified MMLU200/out256 already met50%; current-version efficiency is requalified independently and the90% final target is separate.
